data.headline: Global Market Radar Briefing: Elevated Stress (71.5/100)
data.executive_summary: As of 2026-11-20, the Global Financial Stress Composite registered 71.5/100, reflecting elevated stress. US Net Liquidity has expanded by $23.0B over the trailing 4-week window, while institutional cash participants in India recorded net inflows (FII: ₹1,250.4 Cr) and recorded net inflows (DII: ₹1,840.2 Cr).

sections.title: Financial Stress & Volatility Breakdown
sections.content: The composite score is derived as the arithmetic mean of available cross-asset frictions: Equity: 98.9th percentile, Rates: 62.5th percentile, Fx: 43.3th percentile, Commodity: 85.3th percentile, Correlation: 58.5th percentile. No values are imputed for missing series.

sections.title: Funding & Institutional Positioning
sections.content: Federal Reserve Net Liquidity stands at its current historical baseline with a 4-week delta of +23.0B. Total circulating USD stablecoins aggregate is $282.6B. In Indian equities, cumulative institutional absorption continues to reflect countercyclical domestic liquidity provisioning.
